title: Over 30,000 nuraghe towers on Sardinia
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Over 30,000 nuraghe towers on Sardinia, about Nuragic era at Sardinia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And there were over 30,000 of these things on the island of Sardinia.

plain: Nuraghe are ancient round stone towers found on Sardinia, an island in the Mediterranean. A guest named Tim Alberino tells podcast host Jesse Michels that there were once more than 30,000 of these towers on the island. He raises the number to suggest how large and capable the people who built them must have been.
